payload.text: **AN ARM ON THE PURE HALF STAYS GREEN WHILE THE COORDINATOR DROPS THE VALUE** (2026-09-17, issue 0435). `views::freshness_note` was tested as a pure function for five days while run.rs set the note and cleared it before any frame drew it, and AC-21.1 passed on that arm. Assert where the reader looks (`run::screen_for(..).hint`). Drive a TUI change in a pty through pyte (a scratchpad venv), answering the cursor query `ESC[6n` with `ESC[1;1R` and `ESC[c` with a device-attributes reply, or the explorer refuses the terminal. Read every flag on the row before calling a door filtered: the structural doors silently ignored --tier and --limit.
